features.note: Facade/public/corridor/auditorium hierarchy reads across the presets. In lights-on neutral the warm-lit central spine is visible as a bright band between the two dark auditorium roof masses, the front public band reads as the bright white/red threshold, and the rear service strip stays dark — the plan is legible from luminance alone. Measured band means (lights-on): corridor ceiling 117 / wall 86, sala-3 ceiling 14 / wall 34, lobby floor 168 vs corridor floor 36. Deduction only for the facade preset, whose composition pushes the entrance into the left third.

In sala-3 the low-level rig does reveal the room: blue aisle LEDs run both aisle edges and lay a visible blue spill pool on the aisle floor, amber nosing lines and white step-nosing strips carve the near steps, the rake and two seat-block tiers separate from the floor, and screen bounce lifts the side-wall reveals and the burgundy seat tops. Two green exit-sign bars flank the screen in-room. Held back because the exit bars carry no readable glyph at preset distance and the side walls read as flat uniform ambient gray (mean 34, max 45 — almost no gradient) rather than being carved by the LEDs.

Lobby is the strongest frame: the ceiling cove reads as a genuinely lit surface with visible falloff onto the ceiling plane, the gloss tile carries fixture specular streaks and reflections, the red ceiling fascia and DRINKS/menu boards sit clearly above the wall value, and the counter/kiosk line stays focal without clipping the checkpoint. Marquee and poster bank are focal in grazing. Deduction: in the facade preset the marquee is cropped at the left edge and the frame is dominated by blank white side wall and gray roof.

The lighting has not broken the engineering read. In eng-complete-network the four green RS-485 trunks are traceable end to end, the light-blue LoRaWAN dashes and the solid blue Ethernet chain stay distinct, TC300-01..13 / UC-A / UC-B / UC-C labels and ROUTER-FIREWALL, INTERNET, NIAGARA, PC, TABLET, SMARTPHONE all read, and the external schematic and diagram board are unoccluded. eng-corridor keeps TC300-04 legible with the UG67 antennas visible.

Neutral, grazing, reference-match and the engineering captures each stay legible in their intended state; architecture stays opaque and warm, engineering stays translucent with emissive media that does not bloom into unreadable bands. eng interiors are on the dark side of the spec's 'raise neutral fill slightly' but remain readable.

important_features.note: Lighting does not distort scale: the corridor figure reads at door height, the forecourt bollard/person and the wall-mounted TC300 at chest height keep true size, and no device is inflated to be seen — the TC300 is found by its lit ring, not by size.

The four-tier ladder is present and correctly ordered, with all four tiers visible: bright exterior/forecourt and lobby (floor mean 168, lit ceiling cove), red/white commercial accents above wall value, dim-but-legible corridor (carpet pattern, doors, room numbers, wall-wash falloff from real cove strips and downlight pools all read at ceiling 117 / wall 86 / floor 36), and a near-dark auditorium (ceiling 14, wall 34) that never out-shines the corridor — the ceiling is the darkest surface in sala-3, so the ladder is not inverted. Lights-on/off pairs show real per-channel change in every view: canopy fascia and downlight discs, lobby ceiling panels and kiosk screens, corridor cove strips and wall wash, sala aisle LEDs. Deductions: the marquee sign box and poster bank do not change at all between light_state on and off, the forecourt spill under the canopy barely changes, the sala exit signs go fully dark in lights-off while the corridor exit signs stay lit (inconsistent), and the auditorium side walls are lifted by uniform ambient rather than shaped by the aisle LEDs.
Under the engineering rig, trunks, drops, junction boxes and the UG67 antenna pair still read as attached to walls/ceiling containment; nothing is floated or hidden by the lighting.

defects: facade preset: the composition is off-centre — the marquee and glass door bank are shoved into the left third and the marquee is clipped at the left frame edge, while the right two-thirds is blank white side wall and gray roof plane over an empty forecourt. The intended hero of the preset is the least framed thing in it.

lights-off pairs: the 'Cinemex' marquee sign box and the four-panel poster bank render at identical brightness in lights-on and lights-off (facade, grazing, neutral). These are house/commercial emission channels, not network media, so they should switch. As captured, the frame's most saturated red element is unaffected by the light state.

sala-3 / reference-match: the auditorium side walls read as a flat uniform mid-gray (crop mean 34, max 45 — a range of ~11 levels across the whole wall). They are lifted by ambient, not carved: there is no visible gradient from the aisle LEDs up the wall and no falloff toward the rear, so the near-dark room reads as a gray box with lights drawn on the floor rather than a room lit by them.

sala-3: the two green exit markers beside the screen are readable only as green bars — no glyph or legible sign face at the preset distance, while the same signs in the corridor render a crisp 'EXIT'.
lights-off consistency: corridor exit signs stay lit with the lights off, but the sala-3 exit markers go completely dark. The same life-safety channel behaves two different ways in the same pair.

forecourt: the canopy/marquee spill onto the concrete apron barely changes between lights-on and lights-off — the ground under the entrance is nearly the same value in both, so the exterior tier's brightest source appears to cast almost no light on the site.

grazing: the white shell panels return an almost uniform, low-variance highlight across the whole facade run — the panel joints read but the surface response does not vary, giving a smooth-plastic look at the low angle.
corrections: Reframe the facade preset so the marquee, sign box and glass door bank sit in the centre of frame with the canopy fully inside the left/right margins; reduce the empty forecourt foreground and the blank side-wall mass so the composition is a facade, not a corner.
Bind the marquee sign box and the digital poster bank emissive to light_state so both drop to an unlit (dark red / dim panel) value in the off capture, matching what the canopy fascia already does.

In the auditorium, cut the flat ambient fill and replace the wall lift with real falloff: drive the side walls from the aisle-LED and screen-bounce contribution so a vertical gradient is visible up the wall and a longitudinal falloff toward the rear. Target a wall that is dark near the rear and clearly brighter near the LED line, instead of a single uniform value.
Increase the exit-sign face resolution/size in the auditorium so the sign reads as a sign (glyph legible) at the sala-3 preset, matching the corridor treatment.
Make the exit-sign channel behave identically everywhere: keep the auditorium exit signs lit in the lights-off state exactly as the corridor ones already are.
Add a real spill pool from the canopy downlights and the marquee onto the forecourt concrete so the lights-on/off pair shows the exterior tier actually lighting the ground plane.
